INSERT INTO fx_durable_ga.generic_genotypes (
                id,
                generated_at,
                type_name,
                type_hash,
                genome_data,
                genome_hash,
                request_id,
                generation_id
            )
            SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
                $1::uuid[],
                $2::timestamptz[],
                $3::text[],
                $4::int[],
                $5::jsonb[],
                $6::bigint[],
                $7::uuid[],
                $8::int[]
            )
            RETURNING
                id,
                generated_at,
                type_name,
                type_hash,
                genome_data,
                genome_hash,
                request_id,
                generation_id
